integrity: The universal proof is symbolic and constructive, including infinite sets; numerical verification is supplementary. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies p-morphisms only for full nonempty powerset frames with reverse-inclusion order, not arbitrary finite rooted frames or generalized topless products; the same-model finite experiments reach underlying set sizes at most three. An older equivalent categorical formulation has not been ruled out.
title: Every bounded morphism between full subset frames is a direct-image map
